tasks.title: Maintain CRM 360 backend source of truth
tasks.blockerReason: Fonte canônica do dashboard e semântica dos gráficos exigem decisão humana antes de substituir valores fixos por agregações persistidas.
blockerEvidence: src/modules/dashboard/presentation/dashboard.controller.ts:25,28,47 retorna visitData: [], salesPorPessoa: [] e volumeAtual: 0 incondicionalmente; não são vazios medidos.

src/modules/dashboard/infra/dashboard.prisma.repository.ts:24-32,124-143 consulta Sale/Meta persistidos (prisma/schema.prisma:347-371); src/modules/metrics/infra/metrics.prisma.repository.ts:40-51,63-82 usa MetricGoal/Order. Nem todos os dados são mocks.
humanDecisionRequired: Manter Sale/Meta como fonte do dashboard ou integrar Order/MetricGoal?
Qual a unidade de volume: contagem de pedidos, soma das quantidades dos itens ou outra medida?
Qual o contrato mínimo dos gráficos: detalhamento, período e granularidade temporal?
acceptanceCriteria: SPEC.md describes the API as the backend for LarviFort CRM 360
Business data comes from persisted sources, not mocks
Endpoints provide enough context for operation, auditing, goals and metrics

tasks.title: Preserve layered architecture
acceptanceCriteria: Controllers do not access Prisma, Knex or SQL directly
Use cases or application services contain business rules
Repository ports isolate application code from persistence details

tasks.title: Support operational auditability
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks, appointments and orders expose responsible, status, dates and linked business context
Pedido-task links expose orderId, orderNumber and orderTotal when applicable
Subtasks expose enough data for progress calculation and audit trails

tasks.title: Keep automations and rules safe
acceptanceCriteria: Board rules are configurable and testable
Automations are idempotent and protected against loops
Automation effects are traceable through persisted data or logs

tasks.title: Verify backend before publish
acceptanceCriteria: npm run build passes before backend deployment
Relevant Jest tests pass for changed modules
Protected production endpoints return 401 without token after deploy
Container health and real /api/v1 routes are validated on the correct LarviFort VPS

tasks.title: Implement operational flow endpoints for products, stock, orders, lab, logistics, fiscal and post-sale
acceptanceCriteria: Loop tasks API-015 through API-027 are present in .loop/TASKS.json
Each operational module has explicit endpoint contracts and acceptance criteria
Endpoints preserve auditability and are protected by authentication
Implementation proceeds in dependency order: products, stock, orders, reservation, lab, separation, logistics, fiscal, post-sale, metrics

tasks.title: Expose metrics required by frontend operational dashboards
acceptanceCriteria: Metrics endpoints cover stock, orders, laboratory, logistics and post-sale stages
Frontend can compare visits, clients served, pedidos, estoque and delivery/post-sale data from real persisted sources
No endpoint returns fake operational metrics as if they were production data
